---
title: "Weird mod behaviour when using #define"
date: "2015-03-25"
categories: [imported, notes]
draft: false
---


    #include<bits/stdc++.h>
    using namespace std;
    typedef long long LL
    
    #define MOD (LL)1e9+7
    
    int main(){
      cout<<(LL)1%MOD<<endl;
      return 0;
    }
    
    --Output: 8

It turns out that 
    
    
    1%MOD

becomes 
    
    
    1%(LL)1e9+7

which is 8. After changing 
    
    
    (LL)1e9+7

to 
    
    
    (LL)(1e9+7)

the problem will be resolved.
